title: Apprentice to a Renaissance Painter
hook: Before painting masterpieces, you ground rocks for three years.

scenes.text: Joining a master artist's bottega in Renaissance Florence was not about creative freedom—it was hard labor.
scenes.imagePrompt: Renaissance Florence street view with arched stone workshops along a cobblestone lane. 2D flat cartoon illustration, thick dark outlines, warm muted palette, hand-painted textures, vertical 9:16, no people in the foreground, no text, no logos

scenes.text: As a young apprentice, you spent your first years sweeping floors, boiling glues, and preparing gesso plaster.
scenes.imagePrompt: Rustic wooden studio workbench with clay pots of gesso, animal glue, and brushes. 2D flat cartoon illustration, thick dark outlines, warm muted palette, hand-painted textures, vertical 9:16, no people in the foreground, no text, no logos

scenes.text: You spent hours grinding toxic mineral stones like cinnabar, lead white, and lapis lazuli into fine powders.
scenes.imagePrompt: Heavy stone mortar and pestle surrounded by vibrant red, blue, and gold pigment powders. 2D flat cartoon illustration, thick dark outlines, warm muted palette, hand-painted textures, vertical 9:16, no people in the foreground, no text, no logos

scenes.text: You mixed crushed pigments with egg yolk to produce tempera paint that dried in seconds.
scenes.imagePrompt: Glazed ceramic dishes holding freshly mixed egg-tempera paints and fine sable brushes. 2D flat cartoon illustration, thick dark outlines, warm muted palette, hand-painted textures, vertical 9:16, no people in the foreground, no text, no logos

scenes.text: Only after years of copying the master's sketches were you permitted to paint a background tree or drapery.
scenes.imagePrompt: Easel with a half-finished wooden panel painting of Tuscan hills in morning light. 2D flat cartoon illustration, thick dark outlines, warm muted palette, hand-painted textures, vertical 9:16, no people in the foreground, no text, no logos

scenes.text: Would you endure years of rock grinding to become an artist? Tell us in the comments and follow for daily history!
